glosses: to fill with wax (Wachs) or polish (Wichse)

examples.text: Wahr, daß die Bienen auch noch so fein gearbeitete Rahmen bei den feinen Ritzen verwichsten, und dadurch die Absonderung erschwerten.
examples.translation: True that the bees waxed however finely worked frames at the fine crannies and thereby made separation harder.
examples.english: True that the bees waxed however finely worked frames at the fine crannies and thereby made separation harder.
